def trace_is_valid(trace):
    if type(trace) is not list:
        raise TypeError('trace_not_list')
    if any(type(item) is not str for item in trace):

        'supervisor:dispatch:commercial',

        'supervisor:awaiting_approval',

    return trace == expected
